2026-01-01.title: Thinking Comes First
2026-01-01.verse: Do not be conformed to this present world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may test and approve what is the will of God—what is good and well-pleasing and perfect.
2026-01-01.observation: Many times, people think they can act their way into right believing. They think that if they can only "act right," they will believe rightly. However, the Bible does not say that we act our way into holiness. The Bible says allow God to change us from the inside out. We allow God to transform the way we think. This leads to right living, which leads to freedom. Here is an example. Imagine I told you that you needed to lose 10 pounds. I could tell you what to do to lose the weight and you might be successful. The problem is you would always need me to tell you what to do. However, if I told you why you do things and what to do, eventually you would not need me. You would be able to do it on your own and have freedom. This is what God's Word is telling us. God is not interested in having robots. He wants us to know why we do the things we do. We do not read God's Word only because He tells us to read. We read God's Word because meditating on God's Word helps us to know Him. He wants to teach us how to think, which leads to right believing. Right believing leads to right action. Right action leads to total freedom.
2026-01-01.application: Allow God's Word to transform how you think.
2026-01-01.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for teaching us every day.

2026-01-02.title: A Cheat Code of the Cheat Code
2026-01-02.verse: Love does no wrong to a neighbor. Therefore love is the fulfillment of the law.
2026-01-02.observation: Jesus was once asked if there was a "cheat code" to getting the Old Testament law correct. Jesus said we are to love God and love our neighbor. Doing both of these gets us there in most of the ways that matter. Paul doubles down on this by saying that focusing on what is the most loving thing to be done fulfills the law. If you want to simplify the two commands of Jesus down to one, Paul says it would simply be to live your life in a way that shows love in all things. Now, this does not mean that we never speak the truth toward others or initiate conflict. Sometimes the most loving thing we can do is to warn people of a coming disaster. However, the goal is always out of a heart to show love.
2026-01-02.application: How do you need to show love to someone today?
2026-01-02.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for showing love to us in a way that shows us how to do so for others.

2026-01-03.title: Walk With Others
2026-01-03.verse: Now receive the one who is weak in the faith, and do not have disputes over differing opinions. One person believes in eating everything, but the weak person eats only vegetables.
2026-01-03.observation: In this passage, Paul is talking about the subjective parts of God's Word. There are clear essentials that we all consider non-negotiables of our faith. One of these would be that we believe Jesus is the Son of God. Without this, there is no Christianity. In these essentials, there is no room for subjective interpretation. However, Paul is not talking about the objective true beliefs that we all rally around. He is speaking about the subjective truths where Christians can differ and still be on the "same team." For example, Paul talks about eating food that is offered to idols. For some, they did not see this as a problem because they did not see the idols as real. Therefore, the prayers prayed over them were empty and did not matter. However, other people may have felt a guilty conscience due to the issue of not wanting anything that took away from the sovereignty of God. For many, this issue could be argued either way. This is what Paul is talking about. Where there is vague subjectivity, walk with people and do not allow ourselves to be divided. This is a great lesson for us today. Is it possible we are aligning ourselves with people who do not share our essential beliefs? Are we creating barriers for people over subjective beliefs? This is something to think over and make some decisions about.
2026-01-03.application: Take some time and think about what you consider to be non-negotiable beliefs.
2026-01-03.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us the chance to walk with others who are not exactly like us.

2026-01-04.title: Living in Harmony
2026-01-04.verse: Now may the God of endurance and comfort give you unity with one another in accordance with Christ Jesus,
2026-01-04.observation: When someone sings, there are two types of singing that I enjoy. One type is singing in unison and the other is singing in harmony. Singing in unison is beautiful because it requires both singers to be very skillful and to sing the exact same pitch the exact same way. It is masterful and very hard to do. The other type of singing that I enjoy (perhaps even more than unison) is singing in harmony. I love this because it requires two singers to sing two different notes that go together. The voices will separate, come together, twist, and turn around into something that is beautiful and artistic. This is what Paul is saying our lives should be like in the Christian community. We are to complement one another, not always be exactly the same. We agree on the essentials, but have grace in the non-essentials. We are strong where others are weak and they are strong where we are weak. Doing this creates a beautiful masterpiece that brings glory to God.
2026-01-04.application: Work to harmonize with other believers today.
2026-01-04.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us the ability to give the kind of grace we want to receive from others. We are all different and that is a good thing.

2026-01-05.title: Create Clear Boundaries
2026-01-05.verse: Now I urge you, brothers and sisters, to watch out for those who create dissensions and obstacles contrary to the teaching that you learned. Avoid them!
2026-01-05.observation: God’s Word speaks out that not everyone is a good influence. For those people who continually cause division, it’s important to create boundaries to guard our hearts and guard the unity of the local congregation. This is not always easy, and we should always make clear access roads to restore relationship. However, we should be careful to keep unity and create clear boundaries for those who will not walk in unity with others.
2026-01-05.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us clear guidelines.

2026-01-06.title: Look and See the Lord
2026-01-06.verse: Look at the nations and pay attention! You will be shocked and amazed! For I will do something in your lifetime that you will not believe even though you are forewarned.
2026-01-06.observation: In today’s passage, the Lord is telling the prophet that if he will look around, he would be able to see God moving. Many times we think of something like this and look to the amazing sunrise or the majestic sunset. We see the way the tide of the oceans move with the moon or the life all around us and realize there must be a God. However, in this passage, the prophet is told to also look at the bad things happening and notice God is moving. We do not often think about this, but there is truth to be found. God does not only move through beautiful miracles. He also moves through difficult circumstances. This is not to say God is the author of evil, because He is not. Evil is the privation of good. But, that does not stop God from being able to still use it to accomplish His ultimate will. If you do not believe this, ask a mother. She will tell you she probably hated the moment of delivering her baby, but would do it again to have the resulting baby. Many times, it is just on the other side of a difficult season that we find God’s greatest gifts.
2026-01-06.application: Reframe how you see difficulties today. See them as a vehicle God may be using to do something amazing in your life.
2026-01-06.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for using all things for our good.

2026-01-07.title: It’s Not Just For You
2026-01-07.verse: The Lord responded: “Write down this message. Record it legibly on tablets so the one who announces it may read it easily.
2026-01-07.observation: One of the great aspects of this Christian life is that we have the opportunity to be a blessing to others. In communities on the frontier in the past, there was an unwritten social contract among those who lived together. They knew that surviving was the primary goal of every family and it was best done as a group. Therefore, they would come together and help in any way they could because they knew they would need the same help in return. This Christian life is much the same way. When God blesses us, when we receive a special insight into God’s Word, or when we experience God in any way, we should always be ready to share. One way to do this is to keep God’s Word close in our minds. That way, if we are talking with someone and the passage we read that day fits, it can be shared. How do you prepare your heart to share what you have found with others?
2026-01-07.application: How will you prepare your heart to share God’s Word with someone today?
2026-01-07.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us something that is always worth sharing.

2026-01-08.title: Praise in the Darkness
2026-01-08.verse: When the fig tree does not bud, and there are no grapes on the vines; when the olive trees do not produce and the fields yield no crops; when the sheep disappear from the pen and there are no cattle in the stalls— I will rejoice because of the Lord; I will be happy because of the God who delivers me!
2026-01-08.observation: This passage reminds us that outward signs do not indicate God’s goodness. One time, I had to attend a meeting in the evening. Before leaving, my daughter said, “If you love me, you’ll stay home.” Now, this was not because I had not spent time with her that day. It was merely her way of expressing she would miss me while I was gone. However, this moment highlighted how I often unintentionally treat God. I will say, “If you love me, You’ll do what I like. You will make all things appear great in my eyes. You’ll make the sun always shine.” However, this is not how God shows His love. God shows His love in the sunshine and in the rain. Actually, some of my greatest experiences with God were not in the sunshine. They were in the darkness. It was there I saw how powerful the Lord really is and how much He loves us. This does not mean we desire bad times to come. It means we no longer fear walking through them alone. We see difficult seasons as opportunities for seeing the greatness of God.
2026-01-08.application: Reframe your difficulty today as an opportunity to see the Lord in a fresh way.
2026-01-08.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for walking with us in all things.

2026-01-09.title: Harmony Not Unison
2026-01-09.verse: I urge you, brothers and sisters, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to agree together, to end your divisions, and to be united by the same mind and purpose.
2026-01-09.observation:
When I led a choir, I did not like it when the entire group sang in unison. I preferred harmony. Here is why. 

Unison- 

- You can detect errors more. (Most people do not have perfect pitch.)
- Not everyone can do it well.
- It’s bland.
- It can create a monotone if the notes do not vary enough.

Harmony- 

- Beautiful sound.
- Hides slight imperfections in tone and pitch. (We’re still singing the same song. We just don’t all have to be pro-level singers.)
- Wows the audience.

These are great reasons to not try to be in unison but to live in harmony.
2026-01-09.application: Strive for harmony. Unity within diversity.
2026-01-09.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for helping us love people at whatever level of spiritual growth they are at.

2026-01-10.title: God is the Hero
2026-01-10.verse: My conversation and my preaching were not with persuasive words of wisdom, but with a demonstration of the Spirit and of power, so that your faith would not be based on human wisdom but on the power of God.
2026-01-10.observation: Paul is talking about how he came to the church. He did not come trying to make something of himself. He could have rallied people and used his influence and celebrity to point people to Christ. We have people in our culture who claim to be doing that today. They want to become as big and well known as possible so they can lead people to Jesus. Paul had a different approach. He let Jesus be the hero and central focus. He purposefully kept his message simple and let the power of God make the difference.
2026-01-10.application: Do you strive to be known or to make sure Jesus is known? Who is the hero of your story? What do you need to do about it?
2026-01-10.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for loving us and leading us along the way.

2026-01-11.title: Part of the Team
2026-01-11.verse: The one who plants and the one who waters work as one, but each will receive his reward according to his work.
2026-01-11.observation: There is a new issue plaguing people in the mental health arena. It goes by many names. One of those names is “Hero syndrome.” Someone who has this issue feels as though they are living in a movie and they are the main character. Everyone and everything else in the world is a subplot or sub character to their life. There are so many obvious problems with this extreme form of self-centered thinking. This causes us to devalue the thoughts and experiences of others, it heightens our feelings of self-worth, and it robs us of so many other joys. It also places entirely too much pressure on ourselves to perform, to have things work in our favor, etc. This verse highlights the need to realize the Kingdom of God is bigger than us. We are not intended to “reach the world.” We are intended to impact OUR WORLD. We do our best. We plant or water the fields. God does the rest with His endless resources. It’s good to be PART OF a Heavenly team.
2026-01-11.application: Stop thinking it all rests on your shoulders. Be part of God’s Team.
2026-01-11.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for letting us play a part on Your team.

2026-01-12.title: Spiritual Fathers
2026-01-12.verse: For though you may have 10,000 guardians in Christ, you do not have many fathers, because I became your father in Christ Jesus through the gospel.
2026-01-12.observation: There is a difference between teachers and fathers. A father is a teacher but a teacher is not always a father. A teacher is interested primarily in transferring knowledge. A father is primarily interested in growing and maturing the child. A teacher will come and go from your life. A father is interested in the long journey. A father is someone you must be willing to submit to and take the long road with. Be sure you don’t go around only looking for teachers. Allow yourself to be mentored by a spiritual father. Spiritual fathers are gifts from God.
2026-01-12.application: Pray and ask God to put you in the presence of a spiritual father. If you have one, give thanks. Pray and ask God to grow you so you can be a spiritual mentor to someone.
2026-01-12.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for placing wonderful people all around us. Open our eyes to see them for who You have made them to be.

2026-01-13.title: Choose Your Friends Wisely
2026-01-13.verse: I wrote you in my letter not to associate with sexually immoral people. In no way did I mean the immoral people of this world, or the greedy and swindlers and idolaters, since you would then have to go out of the world. But now I am writing to you not to associate with anyone who calls himself a Christian who is sexually immoral, or greedy, or an idolater, or verbally abusive, or a drunkard, or a swindler. Do not even eat with such a person.
2026-01-13.observation: God’s Word warns us to think about who we spend our lives with. I have heard it said we are a combination of the 5 most important influences and closest friends in our lives. Basically, what this means is that you are impacted by those you keep company with. Paul is warning us not to shy away from living in the world. But, we are to “shy away” from those who live in the church but act like those without God. Be sure to choose your close friends wisely.
2026-01-13.application: Choose your friends as though they were in charge of your life. If you cannot trust them with your heart, don’t trust them with your time.
2026-01-13.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being our closest friend.

2026-01-14.title: Free NOT to Sin
2026-01-14.verse: Or do you not know that your body is the temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God, and you are not your own? For you were bought at a price. Therefore glorify God with your body.
2026-01-14.observation: Paul challenges us in this chapter to see our life in a completely different way. It’s the difference between seeing prison doors from the inside of the cell or from the outside. Earlier in the chapter he says they may think they are allowed to do anything, but not everything is good. In the verse above, he helps us understand why. The reason is because we no longer belong to ourselves. We have submitted our lives to Christ. We now belong to Him. He has set us free. Why would we walk back into that prison cell?
2026-01-14.application: Live free from sin as an act of worship.
2026-01-14.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for setting us free.

2026-01-16.title: God Is Able, Even There
2026-01-16.verse: Nevertheless, as the Lord has assigned to each one, as God has called each person, so must he live. I give this sort of direction in all the churches.
2026-01-16.observation: This verse is not saying that you should continue in destructive sin patterns after you come to Christ. It is saying you don’t have to change your “position” in life in order to be accepted by God or to be considered worthy of carrying His Name. You don’t have to have the right job, the right family, or the right social status to be a Christ follower. All are welcome to the table of the Lord.
2026-01-16.application: Stop trying to be something so that you will be accepted by God. Realize God already loves you and grow where you are.
2026-01-16.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for loving us now, even in whatever mess we are in.

2026-01-17.title: Truth + Love = Strength
2026-01-17.verse: With regard to food sacrificed to idols, we know that “we all have knowledge.” Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.
2026-01-17.observation: Knowing the Truth is extremely important. It is wonderful. However, showing love is what makes it all work. You can be right and still be wrong. This is why Paul spends most of this chapter not talking about the truth, but how to apply the truth with love. There is a balance to be found in this. We cannot allow truth to slip in order to show more love. Telling people what they want to hear is not loving them. That is manipulating them. However, love finds a way to express the truth with no malice.
2026-01-17.application: Check yourself. Are you loving people enough to live and speak the truth? Are you loving them enough to do it in a way that honors God and honors them?
2026-01-17.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for teaching us to love people the way You love us. Completely. Fully. Without compromise, in a way that makes us love You more.

2026-01-18.title: Christianity is a Call to Servanthood
2026-01-18.verse: To the weak I became weak in order to gain the weak. I have become all things to all people, so that by all means I may save some.
2026-01-18.observation: Paul spends this entire chapter reminding us that we do not live in our own superhero movie. There is a new psychological term out there called “Main character syndrome.” This is an issue where people feel like they are the main character in a movie and everyone else is a sub character in their movie. This is a very self-centered way to live. If Christianity is a movie, the main character is Jesus, not us. Therefore, our goal is not to make ourselves look as good as possible but to make Him look as good as possible.
2026-01-18.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for the opportunity to live in Your Kingdom.

2026-01-19.title: It’s All About Jesus
2026-01-19.verse: So whether you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do everything for the glory of God.
2026-01-19.observation: Who is really in charge and who is this really for? I know people who act one way at a restaurant and another way at work. They don’t do this out of bad intentions. They do this because they respect their job. They act with an extra sense of professionalism at work because they are representing their company. They don’t realize they don’t just represent their company at work. They represent their company always. They don’t cease to be a team member when they leave the building. This is the same with Christians. We have a sense of “professionalism” when we are at church. We want to represent Christ well. The truth is, the real time we are “on the job” is when we are not at church. We carry the name of Jesus with us everywhere we go. Let’s live up to it.
2026-01-19.application: Don’t act a certain way. Be a certain way. One step at a time.
2026-01-19.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us the opportunity to represent Your Name to the world.

2026-01-20.title: What if someone was watching you?
2026-01-20.verse: Be imitators of me, just as I also am of Christ.
2026-01-20.observation: My kids don’t play by the rules. They do things they shouldn’t and when I try to discipline them, I find they got most of their bad habits from watching me. Therefore, when I am disciplining them, I find myself feeling like I am the one getting into trouble. Paul makes a bold claim in the text today. He is saying they should follow his example. Is he being too bold or arrogant? No, he is saying the quiet parts out loud. People will follow someone and they are likely already watching his life as closely as they can. Therefore, he leans into it. Follow me, because you are going to follow someone and you are likely already paying close attention to me. But, realize I am headed straight for Christ. He is my leader. It’s not a matter of “what if people are watching you?” They are. Where are you leading them?
2026-01-20.application: Live in such a way that you would not mind having your life placed on public display.
2026-01-20.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being the best leader.

2026-01-21.title: Why Do You Want the Gifts?
2026-01-21.verse: But you should be eager for the greater gifts.And now I will show you a way that is beyond comparison.
2026-01-21.observation: Spiritual gifts in the church have been a controversy for a long time. The reasons for this are varied, but here is the bottom line. The Holy Spirit has empowered us for something special. The greatest gift He has given is the ability to be helpful to one another. In the Kingdom of God, we are all on the same team and we desire to serve the Lord together. Therefore, the Holy Spirit is the gift. The tools He gives are there to help us serve each other.
2026-01-21.application: Seek the gifts but with the right motivation.
2026-01-21.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us the opportunity to make a difference.

2026-01-22.title: A Definition of God
2026-01-22.verse: And now these three remain: faith, hope, and love. But the greatest of these is love.
2026-01-22.observation: I have read this chapter many times over the course of my life. It seems really straightforward. The goal is to love others and how to do it. Here’s another way to see it. The Bible says that God is love. It doesn’t say He is loving or He has love as a characteristic. It says He is the definition of love. How He acts and portrays Himself to others is what love is. Therefore, this chapter can be seen as a definition of the character of love and what we seek after in order to be more like Him. This is what we become as we become more like Him every day.
2026-01-22.application: Love others as God has loved you.
2026-01-22.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for loving us the way You do and showing us such a great Heavenly Father.

2026-01-23.title: God’s Presence is the Essence of Peace
2026-01-23.verse: for God is not characterized by disorder but by peace.As in all the churches of the saints,
2026-01-23.observation:
I have heard people say things like, “I like a little chaos in my church services. I want to keep the devil confused.” That’s silly to me. God doesn’t need to confuse or trick the devil. I heard about an old football coach whom a reporter told that the other team knew the plays he would call. He said, “That’s fine. You still have to stop it.” The devil can know exactly what to expect in a church service and he still cannot stop God from doing whatever God wants to do. 

There is a balance to this, though. Church services should not be passive. We should engage in the worship and the learning of God’s Word. This is where we experience life. Churches should be full of life, not chaos.
2026-01-23.application: Be like Jesus. Spread peace wherever we go.
2026-01-23.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being the author of peace.

2026-01-24.title: Pass It On
2026-01-24.verse: For I passed on to you as of first importance what I also received—that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures,
2026-01-24.observation: Paul is passing on an early creed he received from the church. Historical scholars say this creed may have gone back as early as the same year as the resurrection. This was wildly important. Creeds were a way to teach the Gospel in memorable phrases. He was passing on hope to live by. What are you passing on to those around you? We leave a small imprint on everyone we come in contact with. Are people better for having encountered you today? What are you passing on?
2026-01-24.application: Be a bringer of hope in someone’s life today. Double their joy and cut their sorrow in half.
2026-01-24.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being the ultimate source of joy.

2026-01-25.title: Be Courageous.
2026-01-25.verse: Stay alert, stand firm in the faith, show courage, be strong.
2026-01-25.observation: Courage is not the absence of fear. The absence of fear does not require anything. Courage is moving forward in the presence of fear. Moving forward and being the church God intends His people to be requires courage. Are you living for God in a way that requires courage?
2026-01-25.application: Live fully for God no matter where you are.
2026-01-25.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being a God worth serving.

2026-01-26.title: Stand in Awe
2026-01-26.verse: Be silent before the Sovereign Lord, for the Lord’s day of judgment is almost here. The Lord has prepared a sacrificial meal; he has ritually purified his guests. “On the day of the Lord’s sacrificial meal, I will punish the princes and the king’s sons, and all who wear foreign styles of clothing.
2026-01-26.observation: There is a moment when the prophet says for the people to stand in silence and in awe as God shows Himself to be in charge and in full power. Many times, we should sit back and stand in awe at the mighty power of God. God is overwhelmingly in charge and more powerful than anything we can ever imagine.
2026-01-26.application: Take a moment and think about the greatness of God.
2026-01-26.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being so great and still loving us.

2026-01-27.title: Seek the Lord
2026-01-27.verse: Seek the Lord’s favor, all you humble people of the land who have obeyed his commands! Strive to do what is right! Strive to be humble! Maybe you will be protected on the day of the Lord’s angry judgment.
2026-01-27.observation: When difficult times come, it is human nature to want to tell someone. This is why choosing our friends can be so important. We need someone who will listen, not be quick to condemn, and willing to give good advice as needed. If someone does not have good friends, they will continue seeking. There are entire industries making billions of dollars from the need to connect with others. All of this is the way the Lord has made us and is a good thing. However, in all our seeking, we must never forget to seek the Lord. When bad things happen, prayer should be our first response, not our last resort.
2026-01-27.application: Take time today, and pray about everything in your heart.
2026-01-27.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always being willing to hear our prayers.

2026-01-28.title: God is Among Us
2026-01-28.verse: The Lord your God is in your midst; he is a warrior who can deliver. He takes great delight in you; he renews you by his love; he shouts for joy over you.
2026-01-28.observation: This prophetic book has had many difficult things to say about sin and judgment. However, Zephaniah is given a message by the Lord to end the letter that is intended to give hope. The greatest hope God gives us is that He is among us. This is truly the greatest hope we can have. It reminds me of when my family would go through a storm. We would be watching the weather and preparing to get into a safe place if the weather became too difficult. At some point, both of my girls would make their way over to me. They had in their minds that as long as their dad was there, everything would be okay. No matter what, he would know what to do. (Let’s just keep it between us that I was just as concerned as they were.) This is how we can feel about God. When the battle becomes difficult, we can have peace in our hearts that our Heavenly Father is there. He will go with us through every storm and, unlike me, He is not afraid.
2026-01-28.application: Take a moment to realize that you will not walk through anything alone today.
2026-01-28.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for walking with us in all things.

2026-01-29.title: God’s Promises are a Sure Thing
2026-01-29.verse: For every one of God’s promises are “Yes” in him; therefore also through him the “Amen” is spoken, to the glory we give to God.
2026-01-29.observation: There is a phrase in the sports betting world that has entered into mainstream culture. That phrase is called a “sure thing.” This means exactly what it sounds like it means. You can have complete confidence when you bet on this game or event because it is a sure thing to go in a certain way. However, occasionally the unthinkable happens and the bet goes the other way. This is the great thing about God. This never happens with Him. If God promises something, it will happen. God’s promises truly are a sure thing.
2026-01-29.application: Trust the Lord to do what His Word says He will do.
2026-01-29.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being completely trustworthy.

2026-01-31.title: Love Requires Truth
2026-01-31.verse: For out of great distress and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not to make you sad, but to let you know the love that I have especially for you.
2026-01-31.observation: There is an unfortunate idea in the world that love means co-signing whatever someone wants to do. This cannot be true. Love means we are willing to walk with people and love them enough to point out areas that are bringing brokenness and shame. The difference is someone who loves someone else points out the issue, then sits down and says, “I’m not going anywhere. What do you want to do about it together?”
2026-01-31.application: Have enough love to give and receive truth within the context of sincere relationships.
2026-01-31.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for loving us enough to point out the sin and then walk with us toward Your freedom.
